text: per the incident timeline; see linked incident report for full detail. Corrective Actions Add a pre-execution duplicate-trigger check to the billing batch framework (target: 30 days). Introduce a mandatory dry-run validation gate for all scheduler configuration changes affecting billing (target: 45 days). Add a pre-completion alert threshold so duplicate runs are caught before charges are finalised, not only after. Preventive Actions Longer-term preventive measures are tracked alongside the corrective actions above and reviewed at the next governance cycle. Monitoring Changes Monitoring thresholds/alerts relevant to this failure mode are reviewed and updated where the investigation identified a detection gap. Ownership Action 1 completed; Actions 2-3 in progress; owner: Billing Engineering team. Status Action 1 completed; Actions 2-3 in progress; owner: Billing Engineering team.
